title: OpenCode host isolation: no benchmark opencode uses the shared store

source.method: owner request relayed by the PM orchestrator, 2026-11-06: "FAULT, act now." Every opencode that the benchmark starts uses its own data folder, never ~/.local/share/opencode; a trap stops the server at the end of the job; a test fails when the harness opencode would use the shared data folder. Done when no benchmark opencode uses the shared database, and the 11-08 01:00 run uses the new setting.
source.evidence: spec.md EV1-EV14, measured on 2026-11-06: stray `opencode.exe serve --service` from harness/cron-daily.sh:120 at about 04:54:08; ~/.local/state/opencode/service.json mtime 2026-11-06 04:54:08.552313003 +0700; OpenCode v2.2.4 reads HOME, XDG_CONFIG_HOME, XDG_DATA_HOME, XDG_STATE_HOME, XDG_CACHE_HOME, and TMPDIR (`opencode debug paths`); a plain `opencode models` in an isolated folder left a detached `serve --service`, and `opencode models --standalone` left none; test:meta exit 1 with 6 of 250 failed; reports/harness-hashes.sha holds the values of 2026-10-25
